messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync — Finova wants a 10-day POC to move off VendorX. Key asks: API compatibility, prompt parity for support summaries, and identical JSON responses for their downstream parsers.

alin_se: We can build a compatibility facade that accepts VendorX-style POSTs. Need to confirm whether they rely on strict schema validation or lenient parsing.

maria_sales: They said "schema validated in prod" so likely strict. I'll request 50 blocking examples and their schema doc.

devon_re: For parity, plan: 1) run the 50 examples against VendorX and our recommended rdx-13b-compat, 2) collect diffs, 3) add a small post-processor to normalize dates/whitespace and enforce schema.

ops_mar: Ops items: SAML SSO, request-level audit logs to their Splunk, and ability to keep logs in EU region. Can infra provide a staging Private env? @infra_bot

infra_bot: Staging Private can be provisioned; need Finova CIDR + SAML metadata. Will enable syslog forwarder and per-request audit events. ETA 48-72h after creds.

devon_re: Metric targets suggested for SOW: schema exact-match >= 99% on required fields; redaction false-negative rate < 0.5% on blocking set; summarization intent-preservation > 95% (manual eval).

maria_sales: Pricing Q: will migration change per-token price? Short answer: hosted per-token stays the same; we can offer migration credits/temporary IO discounts.

sec_bot: Received Finova_SecQ_0426.pdf. Top asks: SOC2, BYOK/KMS in Private, and retention controls.

ops_mar: I'll draft answers for the questionnaire once we confirm KMS mode.

alin_se: Dev estimate: facade + harness + metrics collector = 2 dev days baseline, 1 day to iterate on failures. If they require exact token parity, that's effectively impossible across model families. Need confirmation on "exact wording" requirement.

maria_sales: I'll get their examples and clarify wording tolerance. Kickoff scheduled Friday 9am PT. Will update here after kickoff. Thanks all :raised_hands:
